text: Provolone Valpadana is a semi-cooked pasta filata of cow's milk that is moulded into shapes from half a kilo to over 100 kg and ripened; the sharp 'piccante' type gets its spicy taste from kid or lamb rennet paste and months of ageing.

steps.note: Up to 6 kg is pasteurised, larger batches thermised at up to 55 °C.
With calf rennet (dolce) or kid or lamb rennet paste (piccante).
With acidified whey starter from the previous make.
Stretched in water, moulded in shapes from 0.5 kg to over 100 kg.
Dolce takes up to 2–3 months, piccante over 3 and stagionato over 8, and it may be smoked.
